summary: Implementation plan to optimize AXHub performance and establish persistent cloud synchronization with Google Cloud Firestore (ai-studio-axhub-29bb6ce1-faf6-4268-ad2b-79eb95d78116). Covers in-memory LRU caching, HTTP ETag responses, client-side virtualized rendering and code-splitting, two-way Firestore repository persistence for domains and scraped bonuses, and hardened security rules.
